272:t_003:1.en:
$$くらら$$
「...Did you experience that too, $$葵$$?」

272:t_003:3.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Then you did too, $$くらら$$... So $$ジョニー$$ and $$エイーダ$$ also...」

272:t_003:4.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Yes... It felt as if all the blood in my body were boiling.」

272:t_003:5.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「It was sweet and painful... But a powerful urge welled up from deep within me...」

272:t_003:6.en:
$$葵$$
「So we all felt the same thing.」

272:t_003:7.en:
$$葵$$
「We've really become a team, haven't we?」

272:t_003:8.en:
$$くらら$$
「It seems we're more alike than we thought.」

272:t_003:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$チームＤ$$'s all fired up.」

272:t_003:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「For the first time in a while, I remembered my journey of battles...」

272:t_003:12.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「A journey... So where will you head from here?」

272:t_003:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's obvious! I'll go higher, farther... and get stronger!」

272:t_003:14.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To all units. Until we can establish our situation, damage to our battleship could be fatal to us all.」

272:t_003:15.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Prioritize intercepting enemies approaching $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$.」

272:t_003:16.en:
$$渓$$
「Everyone! Sorry, but you'll have to protect us this time!」

272:t_003:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You got it! We'd be in trouble if we lost our place to return to, too!」

272:t_004:3.en:
$$メール$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! What's wrong with $n!?」

272:t_004:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's nothing serious. I'll have him join the battle as he is.」

272:t_004:5.en:
$$メール$$
「Huh... You are... Miss $$スズネ$$, right...?」

272:t_004:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's do this, $n. Wherever we are, we have to forge our own path...!」

272:t_005:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, attack! Wherever we are, we will survive!」

272:t_006:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh! How do you like that, you $$バアル$$ bastards!?」

272:t_006:1.en:
$$恵子$$
「You're getting carried away again, $$勝平$$...!」

272:t_006:2.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We won this time, but the thought of those things attacking us over and over gives me chills.」

272:t_007:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Huh? An enemy suddenly went down.」

272:t_008:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「They're $$アンゲロイ$$...! Is it $$サイデリアル$$!?」

272:t_008:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But I've never seen black ones like those...!」

272:t_009:1.en:
$$葵$$
「They're with the $$アンゲロイ$$, so they must be $$サイデリアル$$ forces!」

272:t_009:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「W-what the hell are they...!? Looking at them makes me feel strange...!」

272:t_009:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「My will to fight... is fading...」

272:t_009:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn it...! Am I actually scared!?」

272:t_009:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No. It is awe in the face of overwhelming power.」

272:t_009:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When a small child faces an adult's anger, they do everything they can to beg forgiveness.」

272:t_009:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They don't rebel or resist. They just apologize and grovel until the anger passes, laying bare their own helplessness.」

272:t_009:11.en:
$$號$$
「...The feeling of awe engraved in humanity's genes... Those are... our true enemies...」

272:t_009:14.en:
$$隼人$$
「The fundamental calamity 《$$ガイオウ$$》 spoke of... Wasn't that $$バアル$$!?」

272:t_009:15.en:
$$渓$$
「B-but... Looking at them, I can understand what $$號$$ means...!」

272:t_009:16.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「What is this...? Even a vast army of $$宇宙怪獣$$ never did this to me...」

272:t_009:17.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We can't win... We could never beat those things!」

272:t_009:19.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「I can feel it... They're trying to eliminate us...!」

272:t_009:20.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Their power is dark, cold... and overwhelming...」

272:t_009:21.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It seems they're also the ones who transported us here.」

272:t_009:22.en:
$$ギミー$$
「D-do we have to fight those things...?」

272:t_009:27.en:
$n
「I...! I refuse to bow to those bastards!!」

272:t_009:30.en:
$$シモン$$
「I don't know about awe or whatever, but if we'll have to fight them anyway, we just have to hit them with everything we've got!」

272:t_009:31.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn right! If it's hell whether we advance or retreat, we'll give them hell!」

272:t_009:32.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's what it means to live!!」

272:t_009:33.en:
$$號$$
(Yes. That is what will save the universe.)

272:t_009:34.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Everyone, you've made up your minds, then.」

272:t_009:37.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Those enemies seek to kill our hearts...」

272:t_009:38.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But we are alive! We cannot let them defeat us without a fight!」

272:t_009:39.en:
$$葵$$
「We know! We'll set our lives ablaze!」
